summary: Sarah Chen from Aegis Cloud Security support followed up with Derek Owens of Crestline Wealth to verify the fix for persistent Aegis Identity policy sync delays (original case 7615) after his tenant moved to a dedicated sync worker. Derek confirmed policy changes now propagate in about two to five minutes, a 300-user group restructure completed in twelve minutes, and twenty new hires were provisioned within three minutes. He reiterated that the earlier five-day response gap was a regulatory concern for a wealth management firm, and Sarah explained the new P2 escalation rule that pages on-call after eight business hours without a response. Derek requested self-service visibility into sync latency; Sarah offered an API script and logged a dashboard feature request. The case will close after one more week of monitoring, and the dedicated worker is permanent.
actionItems: Sarah Chen: Send Derek the case summary including the new P2 escalation policy in writing today
Sarah Chen: Send a sample script for the Identity sync job status API today
Sarah Chen: Log a feature request for an in-console sync latency dashboard with the Identity product team
Derek Owens: Monitor policy sync latency for one more week and report any delays above ten minutes
Sarah Chen: Resolve case 8124 after one week if latency stays under ten minutes
